title: The Bank That Only Accepts Deposits of Human Tears
hook: Deep beneath Zurich, a vault exists where the only currency accepted is emotional distress—and billionaires pay millions for access.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visceral, emotional hook triggers immediate revulsion and curiosity—viewers must know how this works.

title: The Billionaire Who Paid Zero Tax by Becoming His Own Ghost
hook: He legally died on paper, then used his own 'ghost status' to funnel billions through a loophole in the afterlife tax code.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept of 'becoming a ghost' to avoid taxes is absurd enough to demand a click and share.

title: The Offshore Island Where Money Is Stored in the Bodies of Dead Fish
hook: A remote Pacific atoll where smugglers pack cash into hollowed-out tuna carcasses to evade satellite surveillance.
why_this_can_go_viral: Grimy, tactile imagery that feels like a heist movie—viewers love 'how they hide it' content.

title: The Algorithm That Determines Which Babies Will Be Billionaires
hook: A private hedge fund uses an AI that scans newborn DNA, family history, and hospital data to 'invest' in children before they can walk.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pre-crime meets class warfare—ethically outrageous and deeply unsettling, perfect for debate.

title: The Lawyer Who Drafted a Contract That Owns Your Unborn Children's Debt
hook: A trust document that legally binds fetuses to repay loans taken by their parents—and some billionaires use it like a family credit line.
why_this_can_go_viral: The horror of debt slavery before birth creates immediate outrage and curiosity.

title: The Country That Sells Citizenship to Criminals for $500,000
hook: A sovereign nation with a gold-plated 'forgiveness visa'—fugitives pay half a million and their criminal records vanish overnight.
why_this_can_go_viral: True-crime meets tax haven—viewers love stories of rich criminals buying their way out.

title: The Heir Who Had to Burn $10 Million to Collect $100 Million
hook: A trust fund that requires the beneficiary to publicly destroy a fortune to prove they're 'worthy' of the real money.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sickening spectacle of destruction for wealth—outrageous enough to be shared widely.

title: The Algorithm That Financially Ruins People Who Post Negative Reviews
hook: An AI that scans public complaints, then short-sells stocks you own and floods your credit file with fraudulent defaults.
why_this_can_go_viral: Modern digital nightmare—everyone fears speaking out and being destroyed financially.

title: The Billionaire Who Bought the Right to Tax Every Breath You Take
hook: He purchased a patent on 'air usage' and now charges a micro-royalty to every building that vents oxygen into the atmosphere.
why_this_can_go_viral: Outrageous premise that feels dystopian—viewers will instantly want to know if it's real.

title: The Offshore Vault That Stores Only Classified CIA Documents
hook: A private bunker in the Cayman Islands where billionaires pay to store stolen secrets—and use them as leverage against governments.
why_this_can_go_viral: Spy thriller meets tax haven—viewers love 'hidden document' conspiracies.

title: The Trust That Forces You to Live as a Janitor to Inherit $500 Million
hook: A condition written into a family trust: heirs must work minimum-wage jobs for five years before touching a cent of the fortune.
why_this_can_go_viral: Schadenfreude plus curiosity—people love seeing wealthy heirs forced into ordinary life.

title: The Accountant Who Hid $800 Million in a Single Pencil Sharpener
hook: He hollowed out a vintage sharpener, filled it with micro-diamonds, and shipped it through 14 shell companies—never caught.
why_this_can_go_viral: Incredible miniaturization story—the 'hiding in plain sight' angle is deeply satisfying.

title: The Hedge Fund That Only Profits When You Get Fired
hook: An algorithm that tracks layoffs in real time, then shorts companies that are about to downsize—making billions from pink slips.
why_this_can_go_viral: Profiting from personal tragedy is infuriating—drives high engagement and sharing.

title: The Psychiatrist Who Convinced Billionaires to Pay Him in Secrets
hook: He traded therapy sessions for insider information, then used those secrets to build a fortune—without ever breaking a law.
why_this_can_go_viral: Therapy as espionage—viewers love 'how they exploit trust' stories.

title: The Broker Who Sold Insurance Policies on Strangers' Funerals
hook: He bought death records before families knew, then sold 'funeral insurance' to investors betting on when people would die.
why_this_can_go_viral: Macabre and shocking—everyone has experienced loss, making it viscerally engaging.

title: The Algorithm That Sells 'Poverty Insurance' to the Ultra-Rich
hook: A policy that pays out if a billionaire's net worth dips below $1 billion—ensuring no one ever has to 'struggle' like the middle class.
why_this_can_go_viral: Tone-deaf luxury product that enrages viewers—perfect for ironic sharing.

title: The Bank That Only Opens Its Vaults During Full Moons
hook: A Swiss institution that restricts withdrawals to lunar cycles—forcing clients to plan their wealth around celestial events.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mysterious and weird—viewers love 'banks with strange rules'.

title: The Fund That Only Invests in Companies That Cause Scandals
hook: A hedge fund that deliberately pumps money into businesses on the verge of PR disasters—then cashes out on the chaos.
why_this_can_go_viral: Profiting from destruction—viewers love financial 'villain' stories.

title: The Offshore Bank That Uses Parrots as Security Guards
hook: A Caribbean vault protected by trained parrots that scream the exact account numbers to scare off thieves—and repeat them in court.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bizarre and visually hilarious—perfect for short-form entertainment and sharing.

title: The Algorithm That Predicts Which Employees Will Steal—Before They Do
hook: A secret scoring system used by billion-dollar firms that flags workers based on voice tone, eye movement, and social media—then fires them preemptively.
why_this_can_go_viral: Surveillance capitalism at its worst—everyone worries about being watched at work.
